description: This file defines a store for managing a hierarchical tree of notebooks in the Notesnook application, including functions for adding, removing, updating, and fetching notebooks, as well as managing UI state like expansion and selection.

methods.name: removeTreeItem
methods.description: Recursively removes a tree item and its children from the tree array.

methods.name: createNotebookTreeStores
methods.description: Creates and returns hooks for managing notebook tree state, selection, and expansion, with persistence support.
